more_info.overview: Succinic acid is an organic dicarboxylic acid used for acidity control. Its acidity-regulating role is to adjust or maintain the pH of the food. The specified material is supplied as white crystalline material. EU permissions include flavoured drinks, flavoured fermented milk products including heat-treated products, soups and broths, other.
more_info.uses:
Examples in the EU food-use list include certain flavoured drinks; other; flavoured fermented milk products including heat-treated products; soups and broths; desserts excluding products covered in categories 1, 3 and 4.
The entries apply to particular food categories and may limit the amount, the preparation or the way it is used; they do not show how often the additive appears in retail products.
